text: Completed relation_fit and the initial separable-GLM error channel. lm_relation_fit() compiles pure effect maps plus lazy QR/SVD residual projections, unscaled effect-coordinate covariance, residual df, sampling labels, source/whitener revisions, assumptions, and estimator provenance. The deprecated whiten alias is deliberate and NULL-safe. Product-oracle tests cover GLS effects, residuals, covariance, rank deficiency, partition-specific designs, lazy reads, absent capabilities, and shallow hot-path validation. Scale-enabled full suite passes; canonical tarball installs, loads, tests, and checks, with only pre-existing .claude/vignette-build warnings.
